raw_text: New malware sample uploaded to VirusTotal from India targeting Siemens S7 PLCs. SHA256: a3f7b2c... Detection rate currently 4/72. Behavioral analysis shows it attempts to modify PLC ladder logic for process control manipulation. Code structure shares similarities with Stuxnet-era payloads. Sample appears to have been extracted from a live ICS environment. Community analysis ongoing.
clean_text: New malware on VirusTotal from India targeting Siemens S7 PLCs. Low detection rate. Modifies PLC ladder logic. Code similarities with Stuxnet. Extracted from live ICS environment.
